text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year's Takarazuka Kinen.
Although Jungle Pocket isn't running—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dammit! If I knew it'd turn out like this,
I should've pushed myself to enter!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The pain in my hoof wasn't even a big deal.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a minor hoof issue, Jungle Pocket chose to hold back.
However, she would come to regret that choice.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame! After last year's Kikuka Sho,
she switched to the mile division and has produced great results.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, she enters the medium-distance Takarazuka Kinen
as the proud number-one favorite!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan couldn't run today.
But someday, we're gonna race together
at medium distance again.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because... I made a promise!
And for the sake of that day, today is an absolute must!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu—! Go knock 'em dead!
Show 'em who you are *now*—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by Jungle Pocket's
incredibly passionate rally――

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Dantsu, it's Dantsu, it's Dantsu!
Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Defeating Air Shakur, with whom she split the favoritism,
she has conquered this year's Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, marked me good, huh.
Not bad at all, Dantsu...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks. Alright, I think I've got my confidence back.
I can do this now—even against Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Dants.
Congrats. You've grown so big.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really ain't the same as you were back then.
Before, you were like an errand runner who couldn't
quite handle taking the spotlight, but now...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're doing splendidly,
as one of the pillars carrying the mile division on your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I wanted to look all smug
and proud just like Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan, I haven't forgotten.
Our promise from that day...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's why I didn't just stick to miles, but ran in the medium-distance Takarazuka Kinen like this, and won.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I plan to keep taking on all kinds of challenges!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, with that kind of spirit, you should be just fine moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Racing might be a matter of survival. But we can survive it with our heads held high, right?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll do my best.
And one day, surely—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I believe the day will come
when I can run with Pokke-chan again!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be there. Course I will.
Well, see ya later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A trick of fate. This time, the two of them happened to cross paths without meeting, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day for a rematch will surely come.
As long as both of them keep running in high spirits.
